metaTitle: Custom Recycled Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom recycled lanyards and badges for your eco-friendly event or corporate program. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Recycled lanyards let you promote your brand while reducing environmental impact. Made from post-consumer recycled PET plastic, these 3/4" lanyards offer the same durability and full-color printing as standard options, with a smaller carbon footprint. Perfect for green conferences, eco-conscious trade shows, or sustainability initiatives. Choose from recycled polyester webbing with metal or plastic attachments, and customize with your logo using screen printing or full sublimation.
heroAltText: Custom recycled lanyards and badges with full-color printing and eco-friendly materials
